title: An operational story finished by a query-log delivery can be done, not only dropped
goal: done accepts as a story's evidence an automatic querylog.py apply --push commit on the integration main that its checks read, or new and check warn of an open story whose touches are the query-log store only and name the drop route, so close --summary credits the goal clause it carried instead of printing unmet (ST-rtzdy4nm in SP-kwi4ilty); precheck warns of a committed code-lane item whose check or repro reads the committed query-log store or backlog.py cost figures and names the remedy: a separate item done after the merge, since land runs a code item's checks and repro before it pushes the merge request (BG-ckrasbdn's land stopped at checks in SP-kwi4ilty)

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
T=os.path.abspath("_tools");root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
env=dict(os.environ,GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@e.x",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@e.x")
git=lambda *a:subprocess.run(["git","-C",root,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,check=True).stdout
bl=lambda *a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,os.path.join(T,"backlog.py"),"--root",root,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
git("init","-q","-b","main")
open(os.path.join(root,"backlog.json"),"w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","lane_module":"","land_push":["git","status"]}))
git("add","-A");git("commit","-q","-m","init")
sid=bl("new","sprint","--title","S","--goal","g").stdout.split("new sprint ")[1].split()[0]
iid=bl("new","story","--title","Deliver rows","--goal","rows delivered","--touch","kb/_querylog/**","--check","python3 -c \"import sys;sys.exit(0)\"","--sprint",sid).stdout.split()[2]
bl("answer",sid,"start","--answer","approve","--by","operator");bl("start",sid);bl("claim",iid,"--by","w1")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(root,"kb/_querylog/2026-10"));open(os.path.join(root,"kb/_querylog/2026-10/r.jsonl"),"w").write("{}\n")
git("add","-A");git("commit","-q","-m","chore(kb): query log store, 1 run file(s)\n\nKB-Auto: querylog")
p=bl("done",iid,"--dry-run");print(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr);sys.exit(p.returncode)

import sys,types,io,contextlib;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_land
it={"SP-a":{"kind":"sprint","goal":"g"},
 "BG-x":{"kind":"bug","status":"draft","sprint":"SP-a","title":"cost shows","goal":"cost figures","touches":["_tools/bl_cost.py"],
  "repro":{"run":["python3","-c","import sys;sys.exit(1)  # reads kb/_querylog/ops after a delivery"]}}}
bl=types.SimpleNamespace(items=it,root=".",label=lambda i:i,sprint_items=lambda s:[i for i,d in it.items() if d.get("sprint")==s])
buf=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl,types.SimpleNamespace(sprint="SP-a"))
out=buf.getvalue();print(out)
sys.exit(0 if any("warning" in l and "query-log" in l and "after the merge" in l for l in out.splitlines()) else 1)

gates.question: Which route finishes an operational story whose work is a query-log delivery?

notes:
Filed at the SP-kwi4ilty close (ST-rtzdy4nm was dropped because done refused it). Merged at the 2026-10-12 draft triage from ST-vu4xal5j: land stopped at checks for BG-ckrasbdn in SP-kwi4ilty from the same cause, evidence only a query-log delivery after the merge can make; one precheck warning, the remedy text of the first clause. The delivery commit carries the trailer KB-Auto: querylog and no KB-Work. precheck lives in bl_land.cmd_precheck, so the merged story's bl_plan.py touch became bl_land.py. Gate answered at planning: delivery-evidence.
Premise: done --dry-run on a throwaway project (a claimed story touching kb/_querylog/** and a commit with trailer KB-Auto: querylog changing a file there) exits 1 with 'no commit on HEAD carries the trailer KB-Work', and precheck on a planted bug whose repro text reads kb/_querylog prints no warning (run 2026-10-12, main a5a7459f2): premise reproduces.
Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 19 of 19, "Close credits each goal clause to its carrier, and a research story's check reads its questions' coverage"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
